{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Proportion of -1 values: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).mean():.2%}")

# Check revenue: is it string? does it have commas?
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample of revenue: {df['revenue'].head(5).tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {(df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")

# Check status
print(f"Unique values in status: {df['status'].unique()}")

# Check converted
print(f"Value counts in converted: {df['converted'].value_counts().to_dict()}")"}
